company.name: Kosh
company.shortDescription: Kosh is a financial services platform designed to help people become financially independent.
company.description: Kosh is a financial services platform designed for service providers. The platform uses sophisticated machine learning algorithms to recommend savings plans, allowing blue-collar workers to turn into micro-lenders for their community. Kosh aims to provide affordable credit, automated saving plans in the easiest way possible.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,981,730 to $9,658,520, a 0.97x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 51 (-19).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
